create.name: Romi Ochwani
create.bio:
Romi Ochwani is a meditation and yoga teacher and breathwork guide who founded ByConsciousness, an online school for self-awareness and personal growth. He grew up in India, where he first met meditation and mind training as a child, and he came back to yoga and meditation in earnest during a difficult stretch as a young adult, an experience that set the direction of his work. He has been teaching for about eight years, on Insight Timer, Udemy and Skillshare as well as on his own platform, and has led workshops and retreats in Bali, Brazil and elsewhere.

His courses pair short teachings with guided meditation and reflection. Echoes of Zen works through eleven traditional Zen stories, Speaking Tree spends twenty-one days on the qualities of a settled mind, and A Journey To Meet Your Higher Self looks at the awareness that sits behind thought. Many of his meditations draw on yogic ideas such as ahimsa, contentment and surrender, and he records in both English and Portuguese. He also offers The Conscious Relationship Path, one-to-one sessions on Zoom or in person that look at the patterns people carry into their relationships, and a free seven-part introduction, The Journey Home, for newcomers.

courses.title: The Conscious Relationship Path
courses.description: Private sessions of 60 to 75 minutes, on Zoom or in person, that look at how conditioning, identity and habit show up in the way you relate to others. Packages of three and six sessions and lower-cost intro sessions are offered, with sliding-scale options; booking is by email.

courses.title: ByConsciousness Membership
courses.description: Unlimited access to all of Romi's online courses on his ByConsciousness platform, plus the community area and blog. A monthly plan with a free trial is also offered.

courses.title: Echoes Of Zen: Zen & Meditation for Presence
courses.description: Eleven sessions, each built around a traditional Zen story followed by a meditation that puts its point into practice. A course about slowing down and staying present.

courses.title: Speaking Tree : Harmonious Mind Qualities
courses.description: A 21-day course that takes one quality of a peaceful mind each day, with a short teaching, a guided meditation and a reflection to carry into daily life.

courses.title: A Journey To Meet Your Higher Self
courses.description: Also called I Am Consciousness, this course uses daily meditations and reflections to help you notice yourself as the awareness behind thoughts and memories.

courses.title: Journey of Your Life
courses.description: A self-paced course in eight stages that looks at how beliefs and habits formed over a lifetime, with exercises for choosing differently. Includes guided practices to keep using afterwards.

courses.title: Align With Your True Self: A Journey To Discover Your Dharma & Dosha
courses.description: A nine-day Insight Timer course from Romi that brings together the yogic idea of dharma, or life purpose, with the Ayurvedic doshas. Played inside the Insight Timer app.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Radiate Your Truth: Discover Beauty, Love, And Life Within
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of short guided sessions on self-love and inner beauty. Also available in Portuguese as Irradie Sua Verdade.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Romi Ochwani on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Romi's guided meditations and affirmations in English and Portuguese, free to play on Insight Timer, alongside his courses there.

free_resources.title: The Journey Home: Free 7 Day Meditation Challenge
free_resources.description: A free seven-part course mixing breathwork, mindfulness and guided meditation, suited to beginners. One short session a day over a week.

free_resources.title: ByConsciousness Free Meditation Library
free_resources.description: A free collection of Romi's audio meditations, self-paced courses and affirmations on his own site.

His own story page links his start in yoga to a period of depression; the bio refers to it only as a difficult stretch.
Prices on his site have no currency symbol beyond $; the site's checkout data uses USD.
